evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks!D25 defines the staged scoring/judge structure; the historical Internal Quality Checks!D25 mentions retired reward.toml, resolved by the frozen skill's staged contract. tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has zero-weight render/constraints gates, 0.6/0.2/0.2 scored weights and a 0.05 functional floor. All five dimensions occupy the required suites and parse: gate aggregation is all_pass with binary criteria; scored aggregation is weighted_mean; all 96 criterion IDs are globally unique, weights finite and positive, descriptions nonempty, and the six visual Likert criteria have five points. Every judge has a Playwright stdio server, a resolving prompt.md with {criteria} and {app_context}, and no prohibited model override. The functional judge.toml:14-18 alone supplies verifier via /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and $APP_RESTART_HELPER; test.sh:193 exports that helper before suites run and functional prompt.md:23 directs restart_app. Source-only validation is recorded in per-row-review/evidence/24/structural-check.json (errors=[], raw-index artifact hashes 77/77 match). A static broken app would still satisfy this structural check because app behavior is outside row 24; conversely a conforming app could be harmed by a runtime restart/tool failure, which the structural check cannot rule out. The indexed browser evidence is scripted product evidence, not a configured RewardKit judge or full timing measurement, so runtime wiring remains unexercised.
